_restored_comment: RESTORED 2026-10-15 (bean folio-assistant-63q4; owner: "Fix trust and immz"). 556b5bf1 removed this declaration on 2026-10-14 when the repository moved to the smart-hiv shape (owner: "Smart-hiv doesn't need its own harness. It can just define index.config.json and reference smart-base as a dependency"). That shape still governs how THIS repository mounts smart-base: index.config.json does it, and this file declares no remoteMounts. What it cannot do is let folio-assistant mount smart-immunizations as an instance, because remote-mount finds an instance only by its `<name>.json` declaration. Restored from 556b5bf1^, at the repository root where it was.

_directories_comment: Owner, 2026-10-15 (~10:45Z, B1): the declaration names only what an index mounting this instance has. folio-assistant mounts none of this repository's directories (its override for smart-immunizations lists `directories: []`), so the `library` entry (library/) and the measles `library-l1-recommendation-scenarios` entry inside it (library/l1-recommendation-scenarios/, smart-base's l1-extraction kind) each named a directory that is absent there: check:declared-dirs, check:declaration-resolution `dh4f`. Both are dropped together, since the second is a path inside the first. The files stay in this repository; an index that wants them mounted declares them again, with the measles example given a home that is not read as a library entry.
_avatar_comment: A syringe: plunger, barrel, needle. Moved here from cat-harness/schemas/avatars.ts, 2026-10-05 (bean sod4 #4): an instance declares its own mark. Restored 2026-10-15 with the rest of the declaration (b1bb21e carried it; the 63q4 restore did not).
_builtAtPublish_comment: Owner, 2026-10-14 (B1; schemas/built-at-publish.ts in cat-harness). This instance's JSON-LD @context is generated by `jsonld:contexts` (cat-harness-tools scripts/gen-instance-contexts.ts) from the prefixes and content-context terms its documents use, flattened with the prefix tables of every instance it needs. Those tables are read at the CHECKOUT's pins, not at pins this instance's commit names, so no commit of it can hold the file current: it is built at publish and never committed (bean folio-assistant-63q4).
